props.name: activeTime
props.description: Sets a specific time to be active (24-hour format, e.g., activeTime="16:00" for 4 PM).

props.name: direction
props.description: Determines the direction of the time selector ('row' renders items in a row).

props.name: disabledMaxTime
props.description: The maximum time to disable for time display (24-hour format, e.g., disabledMaxTime="16:00" for 4 PM).

props.name: disabledMinTime
props.description: The minimum time to disable for time display (24-hour format, e.g., disabledMinTime="16:00" for 4 PM).

props.name: is24HourFormat
props.description: Determines whether to use a 24-hour time format.

props.name: resetTime
props.description: Sets the active time selector to an inactive state.

props.name: timeEnd
props.description: The maximum time displayed between times (24-hour format, e.g., timeEnd=${16} for 4 PM).

props.name: timeFormat
props.description: Specifies the date format for UI display (e.g., 'h:mm a').

props.name: timeIncrements
props.description: Increments in minutes for the time display.

props.name: times
props.description: Container for the current times within the month.

props.name: timeSelectorLabel
props.description: The label for the time selector heading.

props.name: timeStart
props.description: The minimum time displayed between times (24-hour format, e.g., timeStart=${16} for 4 PM).

events.name: onTimeSelectorListChange
events.description: Fired when a time is selected. Detail: `{ value }` — formatted per `timeFormat`.
